Cảnh 1 – Phát hiện lỗi
Create an 8-second photorealistic cinematic video, vertical 9:16.

MAIN CHARACTER: CHAR-02 LINH.

Linh is a 27-year-old Vietnamese female electronics technician with a natural oval face, warm light-medium Asian skin, dark brown eyes, and straight black hair tied in a neat low ponytail.

She wears a charcoal-gray technician shirt with subtle teal accents, dark work trousers, and a small teal name patch reading "LINH".

LOCATION:
A modern, realistic electronics repair workshop in Vietnam.

ACTION:
A black robotic vacuum cleaner is sitting on a perfectly flat wooden floor. It repeatedly attempts to move forward but stops and signals an error.

Linh kneels beside the robot, observes the unusual behavior, and looks slightly puzzled.

She gently lifts the robot after switching it off and inspects the underside.

CAMERA:
Start with an extreme close-up of the robot's wheels, then smoothly move toward Linh's focused face.

LIGHTING:
Soft cinematic workshop lighting, natural skin texture.

AUDIO:
Realistic robotic motor sounds, subtle error beeps, natural workshop ambience.

No dialogue. No subtitles.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
Use the supplied LINH reference images. Preserve exactly the same face, hairstyle, outfit, age, and body proportions throughout the video.

Cảnh 2 – Tìm nguyên nhân
Create an 8-second photorealistic cinematic video, vertical 9:16.

MAIN CHARACTER: CHAR-02 LINH.

Use the exact same Linh character reference images and outfit from Scene 1.

LOCATION:
The same electronics repair workshop.

ACTION:
Linh places the powered-off robotic vacuum upside down on a padded repair mat.

She examines the cliff sensors located underneath the robot.

Using a small inspection light, she notices dirt and residue covering one of the optical sensor windows.

She carefully compares the dirty sensor with the other clean sensors.

CAMERA:
Macro close-up of the optical sensor window, followed by an over-the-shoulder shot showing Linh examining the robot.

AUDIO:
Subtle ASMR sounds of tools touching the workbench.

TECHNICAL ACCURACY:
The dirty cliff sensor is a possible cause of the false cliff-detection error. Do not show Linh concluding that the sensor is faulty before testing.

No dialogue. No subtitles.

Maintain exactly the same character identity and workshop continuity.


Cảnh 3 – Sửa chữa
Create an 8-second photorealistic cinematic video, vertical 9:16.

MAIN CHARACTER: CHAR-02 LINH.

Preserve the exact same face, hairstyle, outfit, and workshop environment.

ACTION:
Linh gently cleans the dirty cliff sensor window using a suitable soft cleaning tool.

The camera shows a detailed before-and-after comparison of the optical window.

She inspects the sensor again and confirms that the visible residue has been removed.

She carefully returns the robotic vacuum to its normal position.

CAMERA:
Extreme macro close-ups of the cleaning process, realistic hand movements, shallow depth of field.

AUDIO:
Soft ASMR cleaning sounds, natural workshop ambience.

No dialogue. No subtitles.

IMPORTANT:
Show only realistic, mechanically plausible cleaning actions. Do not invent electronic components or unrealistic repair procedures.


Cảnh 4 – Kiểm tra kết quả
Create an 8-second photorealistic cinematic video, vertical 9:16.

MAIN CHARACTER: CHAR-02 LINH.

Use the same character and workshop reference images.

ACTION:
Linh places the robotic vacuum on the same flat wooden floor.

She activates the robot.

This time, the robot moves forward smoothly without stopping or reporting a false obstacle or cliff error.

Linh watches carefully, then gives a small satisfied smile.

CAMERA:
Low-angle tracking shot following the robotic vacuum, followed by a close-up of Linh's natural smile.

AUDIO:
Realistic robotic motor sound, subtle satisfying mechanical ambience.

No dialogue. No subtitles.

ENDING:
The robot continues cleaning successfully.

Maintain the exact same Linh identity and clothing from all previous scenes.
